title: Streamlined rename confirmation modal
summary: Replaces the verbose rename confirmation list with a compact batch summary, status badges, and collapsed basename-only details.
reason: The previous confirmation modal repeated full paths and row metadata, making routine batch renames harder to scan.
behavior_before: Rename confirmation listed each checked row as full source path to full destination path plus status, sidecar, and authority text.
behavior_after: Rename confirmation shows media count, sidecar count, target sequence range, health chips, and a collapsed detail table that uses basenames and status symbols by default.
manual_validation: git diff --check targeted rename modal files - passed
rollback_plan: Revert the rename modal renderer, modal CSS, partial copy, related smoke/static test expectations, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: Streamline rename confirmation modal with batch summary, status badges, and basename-only details.
